subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National artificial-intelligence strategy
what_would_settle_it: A national AI strategy or policy document, or a ministerial decision establishing one.
disposition: probed 2026-08-31: a civil-society round table records the absence and calls for a sovereign policy; the national digital strategy carries no AI chapter

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Indian digital cooperation with Madagascar
what_would_settle_it: Any India-Madagascar digital cooperation agreement, line of credit or programme document.
disposition: probed 2026-08-31: nothing admitted to the repository; the gap stands

subject: gov.protect
name: United States bilateral health agreement and its data-sharing agreement
what_would_settle_it: The memorandum of understanding and the related data-sharing agreement themselves, a signature date, or a Malagasy government statement naming the instrument. The text is withheld rather than unpublished, and is in litigation in the United States District Court for the District of Columbia
disposition: not probed on this run; no web access on the nightly pass

subject: dpi.registry
name: National address register
what_would_settle_it: A national addressing standard, a state address register or a mandate for one.
disposition: probed 2026-08-31: the national geographic institute's own status report states spatial data infrastructures are not yet implemented; the only in-window development is a community-built mobile layer with no legal standing

subject: geopol.usa
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: United States digital investment engagement
what_would_settle_it: A United States hyperscaler memorandum, a development finance commitment, or the text of the 2004 investment-agency memoranda.
disposition: probed 2026-08-31: nothing more recent than the 2019 investment climate statement found

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: A year-end execution report or the loi de règlement for 2024 or 2025 giving payment against the digital lines, read into the budget extract; only the FDTIC's own accounts carry an outturn.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Recurrent financing for the biometric identity system after PRODIGY
what_would_settle_it: A budget line, decree or CNECI budget providing for the operation and maintenance of the identity database after the project's June 2026 close.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: A government cloud or hosting policy, data classification or national data policy fixing where state data is held; the national data policy was still being drafted.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Source code, operating skills and exit for the identity management system
what_would_settle_it: The IN Groupe contract or a UGD, CNECI or audit statement on source-code ownership, administrative control and exit terms.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data jurisdiction, portability and exit terms of the Huawei state network and the IN Groupe contract
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the 2020 China Eximbank-financed network contract or the IN Groupe identity contract, with their data, portability and exit clauses.
